verdicts.rationale: The LOW portability concern is limited to compilers or strict language modes that reject the REAL*8 extension; this declaration specifies eight-byte storage on the supported GNU/Intel implementations, rather than leaving the element kind at default real. The independently real precision issue in other_wording is the unkinded constructor literals, which round at default-real precision before widening when default real is narrower than eight bytes; scripts/generate.py:239-251 preserves those literals and morphevolution.F90:3055-3169 uses the table without restoring that precision. No MED numerical impact or varying eight-byte element precision across the supplied builds is demonstrated.

The missing local IERROR tests do not establish the claimed silent cascade: xmpi.F90:210-245 installs comm_errhandler on MPI_COMM_WORLD before splitting the compute communicator, and no returning error-handler configuration was found. That handler reports the error and calls halt_program, which reaches xmpi_abort and STOP (xmpi.F90:314-320,1680-1704); datatype operations likewise have fatal default handling rather than a configured return-and-continue path.
